findings.issue: Site was reached over plain HTTP (or redirected to it); HSTS only works over HTTPS.
findings.remediation: Serve the site over HTTPS and redirect all HTTP traffic to it, then add HSTS.

findings.issue: script policy allows 'unsafe-inline'; no frame-ancestors (clickjacking protection relies on X-Frame-Options); no base-uri directive.
findings.remediation: Define a policy, e.g.: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'. Use nonces/hashes instead of 'unsafe-inline'.

findings.issue: 'unsafe-url' can leak full URLs to third parties.
Powerful browser features (camera, mic, geolocation) are not explicitly restricted.
findings.remediation: Add: Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=() (allow only what you use)

findings.issue: Pages opened cross-origin keep a reference to this window, enabling some side-channel attacks.
Other origins can load this site's resources, aiding Spectre-style leaks.
Not set. Only required if you need cross-origin isolation (e.g. SharedArrayBuffer).
findings.remediation: Add: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp (only if you need cross-origin isolation)

findings.issue: Legacy XSS auditor is deprecated and can introduce vulnerabilities in old browsers.
findings.remediation: Set 'X-XSS-Protection: 0' or remove it, and rely on CSP instead.

findings.issue: Discloses server/framework technology and version, which helps attackers target known vulnerabilities.
findings.remediation: Remove or genericise the Server header in your web server / framework config.

findings.issue: Discloses server/framework technology and version, which helps attackers target known vulnerabilities.
findings.remediation: Remove or genericise the X-Powered-By header in your web server / framework config.
Set cookies with: Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax (or Strict).
